title: Analysis code for functional transitions under persistent metabolic burden in CHARLS and HRS
description: Versioned statistical analysis code for harmonized CHARLS and HRS analyses of depressive symptoms, memory, sustained ADL independence, disability transition, and death under persistent metabolic burden. Version 1.1.1 adds standardized absolute risks, marginal risk-ratio E-values, physical-activity-adjusted sensitivity analyses, and landmark analyses. No participant-level data, derived data, numerical results, figures, or manuscript files are included.
